_note: One entry per screenshot slot; captures go in raw/<kind>/<locale>/<slot>.png and are pasted untouched (never repainted — retake instead). headline: *asterisks* = accent colour in display italic, \n = forced line break, max 2 lines. sub: one benefit, max 2 lines. theme: sand | clay, alternated across the set. tilt: true tilts the device (hero slide only). Apple/Google rules: no prices, URLs, copyright symbols or unverifiable claims; real UI only; localise every language the listing supports (pt-BR, en, da).
